scripts.postinstall: bash -c 'cd /home/runner/workspace/apps/web && npm install && npx prisma generate'
scripts.build: bash -c 'cd /home/runner/workspace/apps/web && npx prisma db push && npx esbuild prisma/seed.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=.seed-compiled.js --external:@prisma/client && node .seed-compiled.js && rm .seed-compiled.js && npm run build && cp -r /home/runner/workspace/apps/web/public /home/runner/workspace/apps/web/.next/standalone/public && cp -r /home/runner/workspace/apps/web/.next/static /home/runner/workspace/apps/web/.next/standalone/.next/static'
